text:
anya (Growth): Hey design — we need a prioritized set of benchmark visuals for the webinar (Wed) and launch socials. Main ask: a single cohesive kit so comms can mix+match. High level: hero slide, one-pager, 3 social card sizes, and an explainer diagram. Deadline: EOD Monday for first drafts.

leo (Design): Got it. Can you confirm which metrics to show and the visual hierarchy? hero should surface the headline stat, one-pager has 2–3 charts, socials need short blurb variants, right? :+1:

maria (PM): Yep. Prioritize these metrics in order: 1) median latency (tail percentiles optional), 2) cost per 1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), 3) throughput (tokens/sec). For hero: "Predictable inference at 1/3 the unit cost" (working copy). For diagram: show routing fallback -> cache -> quantization.

anya (Growth): exactly — hierarchy: hero headline (cost reduction), subhead (latency reliability), secondary callouts for throughput + routing. Social copy variations: short (one-line), medium (two lines + CTA), long (teaser with webinar RSVP). Use the benchmark palette (link below).

sam (DesignOps): File types + deliverables checklist: SVG/AI for vector, PNG/JPEG for socials (3 sizes), PPTX for slide, PDF for one-pager. Naming convention: `redwood_bench_<asset>_<variant>_<size>_<v1>.ext` e.g. `redwood_bench_hero_a_1920x1080_v1.png`. Also include a 1:1 square social and a 4:5 vertical.

leo (Design): Thanks. Two questions: 1) Do we need raw chart data to redraw visuals, or can we use screenshots? 2) Brand compliance: are there any new guardrails? I have the latest brand tokens but want to be sure on type scale and logo lockups for partner co-branding.

james-k (Eng): I can push a cleaned CSV and a compact JSON with percentile points. Key numbers (latest prod run): median latency 42ms, p95 120ms, cost per 1k tokens hosted $0.65, dedicated $0.22, throughput 850 tokens/sec. Link to artifacts: https://files.redwood/test-bench/1860001111 (csv, json, run-notes).

maria (PM): use raw data to redraw charts — avoid screenshots so type/spacing match brand. On guardrails: marketing updated color contrast and logo spacing last month — follow the brand tokens doc in the repo. I'll paste the exact link in the channel after.

leo (Design): Perfect — we'll redraw. Plan: A) hero (one headline + micro-stats strip), B) one-pager (overview + 3 mini charts + callouts), C) socials (3 copy lengths x 3 sizes), D) explainer diagram (routing + fallback). I'll deliver initial comps Monday EOD.

design-bot: New design request recorded: ID #D-2026-394. Please attach files to the ticket and tag @leo. Due: 1860087600.

anya (Growth): Thank you all. Small ask: for the social cards, prioritize variants that call out "Hosted vs Dedicated" numbers — that's what prospects keep asking about in demos. Also include an alternate headline that focuses on reliability for enterprise audiences.

leo (Design): Noted. Will include "cost-first" and "reliability-first" headline variants.

anya (Growth): Awesome. If anyone has blocking feedback before EOD Fri, flag here. Otherwise we'll expect Monday comps and start localization for EU/APAC after review. :rocket:

maria (PM): I'll run a quick compliance check on Monday morning once the comps land.

james-k (Eng): ping me if you need any additional time-series slices for the explainer diagram — I can generate smaller windows (1min/5min).

leo (Design): Thanks — will do.

anya (Growth): Great teamwork — appreciate the quick turnaround! :clap:
